Inge Øster is a clinical epidemiologist and *cand.scient.san.* (Master of Science in Public Health) employed by the [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] (SundK) [^src1]. Within the context of the "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) report, Øster is identified as a contributor to the AFDK steering group, providing epidemiological expertise to the project's analyses and reporting [^src1]. The available documentation mentions Øster specifically in the sections detailing the composition of the AFDK steering committee, which oversaw supplementary analyses regarding waiting times for anticoagulation treatment and the incidence of ischemic stroke and intracranial hemorrhage among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. Because the source material is limited to a single listing of credentials and organizational affiliation, no further biographical details or specific individual claims are available in the current corpus.
